reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I reorder Toplux or Goli when it runs out. I don't need a sachet to go, I travel twice a month and can toss my own bottle in a bag.
objection: I already have a magnesium I trust and it works for me. Paying $29.99 to switch just for a foil packet doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper per day than what I buy now, or if a trial of a few sachets for travel were cheap and I didn't have to commit to 30.
